# Netsidian 0.4.0

This release makes MCP document and memory workflows explicit, safer and smaller.

- Six focused MCP tools cover search, document reads/creation/updates, and memory recall/remember. Inputs use consistent document IDs, vault IDs, revisions and Markdown fields; existing REST adapters remain available.
- Agent memory is a compact Markdown index with stable keys, scopes and links to documents, folders, boards and maps. Longer details stay in separate linked files. Saves preserve unrelated entries and exact wording, verify persistence and support idempotent retries.
- Search, document chunks and memory recall have bounded JSON responses. Continuation checks revisions; compact connection responses avoid repeating setup instructions. Full setup remains available with `setup: true`.
- Missing or incorrect document-update payload fields now fail instead of silently clearing content. Explicit empty Markdown remains supported.
- Direct document reads by path and safe mind-map configuration-file aliases simplify navigation. MCP capabilities reflect the current credential, including read-only and memory-write access.
- Detaching an attached/local vault uses Yes/No confirmation without typing its name. Permanent managed-vault deletion retains its name confirmation.

Existing notes are preserved without automatic migration. Plain folder references use paths; document and board/map configuration references use stable IDs. Index and detail saves are individually journaled, not a single multi-document transaction.

## Downloads and deployment

Desktop archives cover Linux x64, Windows x64, macOS Intel and Apple Silicon.
Linux requires GTK4 and WebKitGTK 6.0; Windows requires WebView2 Runtime. macOS
bundles are ad-hoc signed and are not Apple notarized. Each archive includes
installation instructions and the license. Verify downloads using `SHA256SUMS`.

```sh
docker run -d --name netsidian -p 127.0.0.1:3000:3000 \
  -v netsidian-state:/netsidian-state ghcr.io/pentaqilo/netsidian:0.4.0
```

The Helm package uses chart version and application image tag `0.4.0`.
`docker-image.txt` records the immutable multi-platform image digest.
